note: 時間絕對值隨硬體與版本改變，教學判讀重點為同一組資料上的執行計畫結構與相對量級差。每個樣本重複執行 loopsPerSample 次再取單次平均，避免微秒級查詢的倍率落在計時器解析度上。多數變體的單次差距在幾毫秒以內，低於使用者感覺得到的約 100 ms，網站呈現時應以執行計畫與倍率為主、時間為輔。

benchmarks.title: 單月訂單區間查詢：substr 包欄位 vs 半開區間

non_sargable_substr.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE substr(ordered_at, 1, 7) = '2025-06';
explainPlan: SCAN orders USING COVERING INDEX idx_orders_ordered_id

sargable_half_open.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00' AND ordered_at < '2025-07-01 00:00:00';
explainPlan: SEARCH orders USING COVERING INDEX idx_orders_ordered_id (ordered_at>? AND ordered_at<?)

benchmarks.speedupRatio: 37.4x（半開區間相對 substr；單次差 1.556 ms）

benchmarks.datasetScale: 7,007 customers（單一熱點重複 2,000 次、已抹除顧客 email 為 NULL，email 無索引）
benchmarks.title: 熱點重複 Email 稽核：GROUP BY HAVING vs 自連接配對展開

group_by_having.sql: SELECT email FROM customers WHERE email IS NOT NULL GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
explainPlan: SCAN customers
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

self_join_distinct.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c1.email FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.email = c2.email AND c1.customer_id <> c2.customer_id;
explainPlan: SCAN c1
BLOOM FILTER ON c2 (email=?)
SEARCH c2 USING AUTOMATIC COVERING INDEX (email=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR DISTINCT

benchmarks.speedupRatio: 134.4x（GROUP BY 相對自連接；單次差 139.544 ms）

benchmarks.datasetScale: 50,009 orders（含 idx_orders_ordered_id 索引，回表取 5 欄）
benchmarks.title: 訂單深頁分頁：OFFSET 25000 vs Keyset 接續標記

deep_offset_25000.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, status, total_amount, ordered_at FROM orders ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 25000;
explainPlan: SCAN orders USING INDEX idx_orders_ordered_id

keyset_cursor.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, status, total_amount, ordered_at FROM orders WHERE (ordered_at, order_id) < ('2025-08-01 00:00:00', 150000) ORDER BY ordered_at DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT 20;
explainPlan: SEARCH orders USING INDEX idx_orders_ordered_id (ordered_at<?)

benchmarks.datasetScale: 7,007 customers；基準內臨時建立 tmp_customers_email (email) 與 tmp_customers_email_lower (LOWER(email))，兩者都不在 schema.sql
benchmarks.title: 不分大小寫比對 email：一般索引用不上 LOWER(email)，運算式索引用得上

exact_match_plain_index.sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE email = 'alice@example.com';
explainPlan: SEARCH customers USING COVERING INDEX tmp_customers_email (email=?)

lower_with_plain_index_only.sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER('Alice@Example.com');
explainPlan: SCAN customers USING COVERING INDEX tmp_customers_email

lower_with_expression_index.sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER('Alice@Example.com');
explainPlan: SEARCH customers USING COVERING INDEX tmp_customers_email_lower (<expr>=?)

benchmarks.speedupRatio: 375.5x（運算式索引相對只有一般索引；單次差 0.412 ms）

benchmarks.datasetScale: 45,016 dispatch_tasks（僅 12 筆 queued，其餘 completed 或 claimed）
benchmarks.title: 高比例已完成任務表輪詢：無索引全掃 vs 部分索引 WHERE status = 'queued'

full_scan_bypass_index.sql: SELECT task_id FROM dispatch_tasks WHERE +status = 'queued' ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at ASC LIMIT 1;
explainPlan: SCAN dispatch_tasks
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

partial_index_queued.sql: SELECT task_id FROM dispatch_tasks WHERE status = 'queued' ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at ASC LIMIT 1;
explainPlan: SCAN dispatch_tasks USING COVERING INDEX idx_dispatch_queued

benchmarks.speedupRatio: 1188.3x（部分索引相對全表掃描；單次差 0.831 ms）

benchmarks.datasetScale: 50,008 shipments；基準內臨時建立 tmp_shipments_created_id (created_at DESC, shipment_id DESC)，不在 schema.sql；回表取 5 欄
benchmarks.title: 運單深頁分頁：OFFSET 25004 vs Keyset 接續標記

deep_offset_25004.sql: SELECT shipment_id, merchant_id, status, fee_cents, created_at FROM shipments ORDER BY created_at DESC, shipment_id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 25004;
explainPlan: SCAN shipments USING INDEX tmp_shipments_created_id

keyset_cursor.sql: SELECT shipment_id, merchant_id, status, fee_cents, created_at FROM shipments WHERE (created_at, shipment_id) < ('2025-08-07 13:02:55', 125005) ORDER BY created_at DESC, shipment_id DESC LIMIT 20;
explainPlan: SEARCH shipments USING INDEX tmp_shipments_created_id (created_at<?)

benchmarks.datasetScale: 20,015 webhook_events（含 1,500 筆 evt_storm_hot 重送與 12 筆 pending）
benchmarks.title: Webhook 重送稽核與待處理佇列部分索引定位

group_by_having.sql: SELECT provider, external_id FROM webhook_events GROUP BY provider, external_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
explainPlan: SCAN webhook_events
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY

partial_index_pending.sql: SELECT event_id FROM webhook_events WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY received_at ASC LIMIT 5;
explainPlan: SCAN webhook_events USING COVERING INDEX idx_webhook_pending
